title: Breadman Works, but You Need to be Patient
text:
Breadman Works, but You Need to be Patient. Breadman BK1060S Two Pound Professional Bread Maker is a good bread machine for making creative loaves of bread, hot and fresh, right in your own kitchen. This bread maker offers a nice, professional- looking appearance with its metal exterior and it has many extras like fourteen different settings for specific types of bread; a fruit and nut dispenser; a built in memory that stores your settings for up to seven minutes in case of a power failure; and the ability to program the bread maker to start up to fifteen hours ahead of time.

All of these extra features are nice, but what matters most is the performance and quality of the finished product. My experiences here have been mixed, but they have improved. My first attempt resulted in a compressed block of bread that was inedible and had to be discarded. I followed the instructions presented in the included recipe guide, and later discovered the problem: The recipe book contains several errors. The recipe I consulted did not have an accurate measurement for the liquids and after looking through the guide, I noticed others errors in other recipes. One recipe, for example, calls for a tablespoon of raisins, which is obviously incorrect. I am a little surprised that the manufacturer hasn't realized these glaring mistakes and made a greater effort to correct them.

Beyond my first experience with this bread maker, I have enjoyed positive results. My more recent attempts with this bread maker have resulted in good, fresh loaves of bread and my confidence in the machine has improved. However, there are still a few areas of concern. One is that the loaf of bread, once removed, often has a patch of flour on one of the corners. This is because the paddle doesn't always mix the ingredients as well as it should and you end up with a flour- coated corner. Another area of concern is the metal paddle. When you release the loaf of bread, the paddle often pops out with the bread and lodges itself in the bottom of the loaf.

Breadman BK1060S Two Pound Professional Bread Maker is generally good, but I have noticed other peculiar qualities that are misleading at first. There are multiple points in the process where the bread maker will go several minutes without making any sound. You will think there is a possible problem with the machine and will be tempted to open the lid, check the settings, and possibly even reset, but you need to resist the temptation. The machine is fine and needs to be left alone. And, I have also learned that if you open the door early on and you have ingredients in the fruit/nut dispenser, it will often drop the extra ingredients into the bread as soon as you close the door. Again, you have to trust that everything is okay and resist the temptation to open the lid. And you need to be careful where you touch- the metal exterior looks nice, but it also conducts heat very well and can get quite hot to the touch.

Hot, fresh bread is a great addition to any meal and the Breadman BK1060S Two Pound Professional Bread Maker is a good small appliance for the purpose of making tasty, creative loaves of bread just like a professional. If you use the included recipe book, make sure to examine the recipes closely for typos and above all, exercise patience. The lack of noise and other distractions are not cause for alarm. Just let your Breadman complete its process and enjoy the finished product.

product_metadata.title: Breadman BK1060S 2-Pound Professional Bread Maker with Collapsible Kneading Paddles and Automatic Fruit and Nut Dispenser,Silver
features: Bread maker with 14 baking functions, including low carb, gluten free, artisan dough, and jam
3 loaf sizes (1, 1-1/2, or 2 pounds); 3 crust colors (light, medium, or dark); 15-hour delay timer
Exclusive, collapsible kneading paddles and automatic fruit and nut dispenser for convenience
Includes collapsible measuring cup, adjustable measuring spoon, and recipe book
Measures 16 by 18 by 12 inches; 2-year limited warranty
description: Enjoy professional results on all your favorite baked goods with a Professional Bread Maker from America's number one brand. Our exclusive collapsible kneading paddles collapse automatically before baking begins to prevent holes in the bottom of your loaf for better results. An exclusive automatic fruit and nut dispenser adds extras automatically, so you can enjoy freshly baked fruit and nut bread without waiting around. Easy-to-use controls offer 14 baking functions, including low carb, gluten free and artisan dough, with 3 loaf sizes up to 2 pounds and light, medium and dark crust color. The delay bake timer can be set up to 15 hours. Our Perfect Bake technology ensures even heat for better baking, while useful accessories like a collapsible measuring cup and adjustable measuring spoon make adding ingredients easy. All this, plus a recipe book with over 80 recipes included.
